messages:
Maya: Heads up — after the candidate CSV import last night we’re seeing duplicate evaluation forms attached to a lot of interviews and, worse, the rubric mapping is off (backend is attaching the generic rubric instead of role-specific).
Sam: ugh. Any pattern on which jobs are affected?
Maya: Mostly mid-senior backend and infra roles. Looks like the import created two evaluation templates for the same job_id and the webhook that assigns rubrics picks the first one it finds.
Izzy: I can look at the webhook handler. Likely the new import path doesn’t set the template_unique_id the same way. Can you share a sample job_id?
Maya: job_id 98342 and 98347 are good examples. I exported a minimal repro CSV and put it in the hiring-ops S3 bucket: s3://redwood-recruiting/imports/repro-98342.csv
Elaine: For immediate mitigation we should add a quick dedupe step in the ATS import job to collapse templates by title+role+version before the webhook runs. Sam can you add that to the runbook?
Sam: yep — will add a temporary checklist item: 1) stop scheduled import, 2) run dedupe script, 3) re-run import. Also adding a Slack broadcast to interviewers.
Chris: Quick Q — how do I know which rubric to use if my calendar invites already show duplicates? I don’t want to rate the wrong things.
Maya: Good call. Short-term rule: use the rubric that contains the role name (e.g., "Backend Engineer — System Design"). If both look generic, ping here and I’ll assign manually.
Izzy: I pushed a small patch to the webhook mapping to prefer templates with a non-null template_unique_id and to log ties. Patch in review: https://git.internal/redwood/recruiting/merge-requests/512 (will deploy if tests pass).
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline started for merge request 512 — stage: integration -> OK -> staging
Izzy: If that deploy goes well I’ll also add a guard so the webhook returns 409 if multiple matching templates exist — prevents silent wrong assignments.
Sam: For the dedupe script I made a tiny SQL snippet that finds duplicates. Sharing here in case anyone needs to run manually:```
-- find duplicate templates for a job
SELECT job_id, title, count(*) as cnt, array_agg(id) as ids
FROM eval_templates
GROUP BY job_id, title
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
Maya: Thanks. I’m going to DM the active interviewer list with the temporary rubric rule and schedule a 30-min refresh for everyone at 3pm today to walk through identifying the right template.
Elaine: Can you add a short video or screenshots to the doc? Some of our contractors join irregularly.
Maya: Will do — will post in #people-ops and tag TA leads.
Chris: 3pm works for me. Appreciate the heads-up.
Izzy: Deploy finished — staging green. Rolling to prod in 10.
deploy-bot: Production deploy started — smoke tests passing.
Izzy: Prod patch live. If you still see duplicates please paste a job_id here and I’ll take a look.
Maya: I rechecked 98342 and 98347 after deploy — duplicates disappeared for 98342, 98347 still had one straggler template; I removed it manually.
Sam: I updated the runbook and added the dedupe SQL + the manual steps. Link: https://docs.internal/recruiting/runbooks/ats-import-dedupe
Maya: Cool — follow-ups: (1) Izzy to add 409 guard and alert; (2) Sam to schedule automated dedupe before imports for next 48h; (3) Maya to run interviewer refresh at 3pm and post video guide.
Elaine: Noted. Thanks team :heart:
Chris: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
